<p class="has-text-color" style="color:#6a7788">A VPN works by masking your IP address and rerouting your traffic through an encrypted tunnel. To understand how a VPN works in your favor, first check what happens if you go online without one.</p>

This makes it <strong>extremely</strong> difficult for your ISP, cyberattackers, or network admins to see what you’re doing online.</p>
